name: smwmusic-sonic-the-hedgehog-4-episode-i-the-ocean-that-brightens-splash-hill-zone-act
title: Sonic The Hedgehog 4: Episode I - The Ocean That Brightens ~ Splash Hill Zone Act 1 (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Splash Hill Zone from Sonic The Hedgehog 4: Episode 1. Was heavily inspired by the Splash Hill Zone Medley heard in the third Mario & Sonic game.

Say what you want about this game, but you can't deny this OST is awesome!!!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F Major (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. D Major (Custom Pitch)
